description: Nvidia GPU Metrics based on the prometheus metrics from github.com/utkuozdemir/nvidia_gpu_exporter

panels.description: Number of performance-limiting throttle reasons currently active: power cap, SW/HW thermal slowdown, HW power brake. Idle and configuration states (application clocks, sync boost) are not counted, and a flag the driver does not report counts as inactive. See the Throttle Reasons history panel for which reason and when.

targets.expr: ((sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_power_cap{instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0)) + (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"}) or (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * 0))) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

panels.title: Throttling

panels.description: Lifetime uncorrected ECC error count. Uses the aggregate total when the driver reports one, otherwise the sum of all reported aggregate uncorrected counters (some GPUs report subcounters without a total). Any value above zero means the GPU memory has produced uncorrectable errors and the card needs attention. Shows 'No ECC reported' when the driver reports no uncorrected-error counters at all (most GeForce cards).

targets.expr: (sum by(uuid) (nvidia_smi_ecc_errors_uncorrected_aggregate_total{instance="$node", job="$job"}) or sum by(uuid) ({__name__=~"nvidia_smi_ecc_errors_uncorrected_aggregate_.+", instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

panels.title: ECC Errors (uncorrected)

panels.description: Current performance state, P0 (maximum performance) to P15 (minimum). Lower P means busier. Vivid blue = working hard, pale blue = idle. This is operational state, not a health signal.
panels.title: P-State

panels.description: Static identity of the selected GPU as reported by the driver.
panels.title: GPU Info

panels.description: Compute mode is a configuration, not a health state.
panels.title: Compute Mode

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which one or more kernels was executing on the GPU.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.
panels.title: GPU Util

panels.description: Board power draw as a share of the power limit in force: the enforced limit when the driver reports one, otherwise the software or default limit.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{instance="$node", job="$job"} / (nvidia_smi_enforced_power_limit_watts{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_power_limit_watts{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_power_default_limit_watts{instance="$node", job="$job"})) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

panels.title: Power

panels.description: The fan speed value is the percent of the product's maximum noise tolerance fan speed that the device's fan is currently intended to run at. This value may exceed 100% in certain cases. Note: The reported speed is the intended fan speed. If the fan is physically blocked and unable to spin, this output will not match the actual fan speed. Many parts do not report fan speeds because they rely on cooling via fans in the surrounding enclosure.
panels.title: Fan

panels.description: Core GPU temperature. in degrees C.
panels.title: Temperature

panels.description:
Current frequency of graphics (shader) clock
/
Maximum frequency of graphics (shader) clock.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_clocks_current_graphics_clock_hz{instance="$node", job="$job"} / nvidia_smi_clocks_max_graphics_clock_hz{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

panels.title: GPU Clock

panels.description: Current frequency of memory clock / Maximum frequency of memory clock

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_clocks_current_memory_clock_hz{instance="$node", job="$job"} / nvidia_smi_clocks_max_memory_clock_hz{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

panels.title: Memory Clock

panels.description: Total memory allocated by active contexts / Total installed GPU memory.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job"} / nvidia_smi_memory_total_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

panels.title: Memory Alloc

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which global (device) memory was being read or written.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.
panels.title: Memory Util

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which global (device) memory was being read or written.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.
panels.title: Memory Utilization %

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which one or more kernels was executing on the GPU.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.
panels.title: GPU Utilization %

panels.description: Throttle reasons over time. A colored band means the reason was active. Hardware slowdowns (thermal, power brake) are serious, software power cap is routine under sustained load, and Idle just means the GPU had nothing to do.

targets.expr: (nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_gpu_idle{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_gpu_idle{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_power_cap{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_applications_clocks_setting{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_applications_clocks_setting{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")

(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sync_boost{instance="$node", job="$job"} or nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sync_boost{instance="$node", job="$job"}) * on(uuid) group_left(name) label_replace(nvidia_smi_gpu_info{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "name", "$1", "name", "NVIDIA GeForce (.+)")
